Analyze Aura.descriptionOnly: only once its emotion aura is read, and for 1 hour after the spell

Anticipate Thoughts.descriptionOnly: if the target fails its Will save, the +2 applies on attack and damage rolls against it too; each miss it makes raises the bonuses by 1, to +5 at most, at the table

Burst of Adrenaline.descriptionOnly: no path: +8 enhancement to Strength, Dexterity or Constitution for one roll, then fatigued for 1 round, at the table

Burst of Insight.descriptionOnly: no path: +8 enhancement to Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma for one roll, then dazed for 1 round, at the table

Call Spirit.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Condensed Ether.descriptionOnly: only within the area; half speed and no 5-foot steps there, and a 20% miss chance on ranged attacks into or through it, at the table

Contagious Zeal.descriptionOnly: weapon damage only; its 1d6 temporary hit points and the +4 to the DC of Intimidate checks against it are told here

Dream Travel.descriptionOnly: no path: the arrival table's rolls (1d20 + 80 for a false identity or a mishap's reroll), a mishap's 1d10 damage, the arrival within 1d10 miles, the 1d4+1 hours to another plane and its Will saves (DC 10, +5 each hour) are the journey's

Ectoplasmic Snare.descriptionOnly: no path: the snare's 1d6+4 damage, its +5 on grapple checks, its CMB (6 + caster level) and CMD (16 + caster level), and the tether's hardness 10 and hit points (10 + caster level + Con modifier) are its own

choices.label: Ego Whip I: the ability score of the –2

Ego Whip I.descriptionOnly: staggered for the first round, at the table

Entrap Spirit.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Etheric Shards.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Explode Head.descriptionOnly: no path: it kills a target of 20 hit points or fewer; one with more than 20 hit points takes 1d6 per caster level (20d6 at most), and the debris deals 2d6, at the table

Foster Hatred.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Hypercognition.descriptionOnly: no path: an insight bonus equal to caster level (+10 at most) on the one check it speeds, at the table

Incorporeal Chains.descriptionOnly: no path: the chains' CMB (caster level + Int modifier), CMD (10 + its CMB), +5 on grapple checks and 1d8 damage are their own

Paranoia.descriptionOnly: only while adjacent to two or more creatures; the –2 on weapon damage rolls is told here

Primal Regression.descriptionOnly: its 2d8 temporary hit points, and the 1d4 Intelligence drain and 1d4 Charisma damage when it ends, are told here

Psychic Crush I.descriptionOnly: no path: the target's +4 on its Fortitude save against it, the –1 hit points it is reduced to and the 3d6 + 1 per caster level damage are the spell's own

Spirit-Bound Blade.descriptionOnly: no path: the weapon's special abilities are its own; a spiritualist's matching emotion gives the wielder +2 on its phantom's two Skill Focus skills, at the table

Synesthesia.descriptionOnly: half speed and a 20% miss chance on its attacks, at the table

Telempathic Projection.descriptionOnly: no path: +5 insight on one skill check against the target, at the table

Unshakable Zeal.descriptionOnly: only on the next attempt within 1 round at a check it failed

Wall of Ectoplasm.descriptionOnly: no path: the wall's 2 hit points per inch are its own; its fear shakes (panics one of 4 Hit Dice or fewer), at the table
